about:
WyoMade Apparel & Craft Goods operates from Casper, Wyoming, where it maintains a brick-and-mortar store alongside its e-commerce site. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The brand offers a range of Wyoming-themed products including men's, women's, and youth apparel (t-shirts, hoodies, longsleeves), headwear (hats, beanies, snapbacks), accessories (stickers, magnets, jewelry), bar and glassware, and home goods such as plush toys and towels. Collections such as MYOMING, BISON MOON, and TOWEL COLLECTIVE organize the assortment. The company also sells officially licensed University of Wyoming merchandise, including an 18k gold-plated steamboat necklace. No information is provided about manufacturing processes, facility size, or production volumes.

WyoMade sells directly to consumers through its website and physical store. The input does not indicate any business-to-business sales channels, wholesale programs, or specific industrial customer segments.

The company has not published a stated mission or point of differentiation beyond its Wyoming-centric branding and licensed university products.
